The '''Glarus Valley''' was a location on the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and was the ancestral home of the royal [[House Panteer]]. It was also the site of both [[Castle Panteer]] and the [[Elysium]] along with it being noted as being the seat of culture as well as democracy on the planet. This valley was a place where the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] nobles were able to resolve their disputes in a peaceful manner.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Glarus Valley}}</ref>

By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it became a land ravaged by war with [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] and [[House of Thul]] maintaining a small presence in the region. In addition, the disciplined forces of [[House Ulgo]] tightened their hold over the region every day. Rumors said that the royal family still resided in the Glarus Valley in hiding in places even House Ulgo was unable to find.<ref name="TORC" />
